visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white blazer and white trousers, sits in the foreground of a large indoor event hall. Behind her is a dense crowd of hundreds of people, mostly young adults, many of whom are holding small white signs with red and black text. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a convention center. The woman poses with her hand near her face, smiling slightly. (2) The scene shifts through several quick cuts showing the woman posing with different small subgroups of the crowd. In each shot, she and the fans are smiling and holding signs. The background shows blurred figures of other attendees and the structural elements of the large hall. (3) The woman is seen interacting more closely with individuals; two women take a selfie with her using a smartphone. She maintains a friendly, engaged facial expression throughout. (4) The final shot is a wide-angle perspective showing the entire hall filled with the crowd. The woman stands in the center foreground, waving both hands energetically towards the camera. The crowd behind her also waves and cheers, creating a highly dynamic and celebratory atmosphere.
